channel.title: Burning Activity Calendar: burning more than usual
channel.description: Districts with far more satellite fire detections than usual in the last 7 days, from harmonized NASA MODIS and VIIRS records.

item.title: Punjab & Haryana: no district burning far more than usual, 8 Nov 2026 to 14 Nov 2026
item.description: Every district is within its usual range for these dates. From NASA FIRMS MODIS and VIIRS detections, harmonized. Not an official warning service.

item.title: Western Uttar Pradesh: 3 districts burning far more than usual, 8 Nov 2026 to 14 Nov 2026
item.description: Kanpur Nagar, Uttar Pradesh: 18 fire-days in 7 days, usual 1.5 (highest in 18 years) Jalaun, Uttar Pradesh: 49 fire-days in 7 days, usual 8.5 (more than 16 of 18 years) Auraiya, Uttar Pradesh: 26 fire-days in 7 days, usual 7 (more than 16 of 18 years) From NASA FIRMS MODIS and VIIRS detections, harmonized. Not an official warning service.
